records.title: Harnessing the power of machine and deep learning for transferring joint species distribution models considering the structure of biotic interactions
records.scope: Continental neural-joint-model advantage did not persist in regional transfer, measured with Boyce indices. Not a matched target-only neural ablation; avoid comparing AUC and Boyce magnitudes directly.
records.metadata_note: Three registry name splits differ from primary author display: Luc De/Keersmaeker, Itziar García-/Mijangos, Sebastian Kepfer-/Rojas. Authors above follow the primary display; preserve this note when preparing CSL.

records.title: Correcting environmental sampling bias improves transferability of species distribution models
records.scope: Virtual-species sampling-correction experiments distinguish internal evaluation from independent prediction and transfer. Not evidence for a target-only ablation gap or a causal interpretation of this study's richness gradient.

records.title: Bias correction in species distribution models: pooling survey and collection data for multiple species
records.scope: Pooling survey and collection data can estimate shared sampling bias under an explicit proportional-bias model. It does not establish what this study's encoder learned.
records.metadata_note: Cite the 2015 issue year despite 2014 online publication.

records.title: Assessing the accuracy of species distribution models: prevalence, kappa and the true skill statistic (TSS)
records.scope: TSS equals sensitivity plus specificity minus one and evaluates binary classification. No claim of threshold independence or invariance to changing negative-source composition; freezing development thresholds is our design.

records.scope: Dedicated rare/undersampled-species alternative using AUC-weighted ensembles of bivariate models. Not support for this study's equal-weight neural-plus-conventional averaging.
